notes.title: Business Magnate 1.16 update
notes.notes:
Business Magnate update 1.16 is now available.

This adds new interest rates, possibility to adjust difficulty even after the game has started, a few gameplay improvements and smaller bug fixes here and there. Details:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942008/b1013ee0195d8e3124471f673ce567d2f44cd92f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Interest rate
  The game difficulty setting now influences the interest rate for loans. Steeper difficulty causes higher interest rates.
 
[*] Adjustable difficulty
  The difficulty setting can now be adjusted during gameplay, after you started the game already, which is useful if the game is for example to easy or too difficult for you.

[*] Stock allocation algorithm adjusted a bit to use the nearest store if possible

[*] The employee salaries summary screen now is a bit more easier to read and has a horizontal line for the total sums

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942008/42fa5f6794c39e4d86fb1e89157c6e9bef53ea79.png[/img]

[*] Fixed a few spellings in the Spanish translation

[*] Adjusted currency conversions (USD - EUR - RUB - CHF) a bit to reflect current exchange rates a bit better if possible

[*] Fixed a graphic glitch in sales data statistics on some older Windows systems

[*] Adjusted landing parachute research points for rocket businesses

[/list]

Hope you like this update! Thanks for all the feedback so far, further feedback is welcome as always!

notes.title: Business Magnate 1.15 update
notes.notes:
Business Magnate update 1.14 is now available. 

This adds nicer HighDPI-support, a few gameplay improvements and smaller bug fixes. Details here:

  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942008/511c4d983e882ebece756c087bf99937364a9763.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] High DPI support: The game now looks much nicer on displays with High DPI support

[*] Marketing campaign queue fixed: When deleting a campaign in the list of marketing campaigns, sometimes a wrong items was deleted. This is fixed now.

[*] When deleting an existing product, the upcoming marketing campaigns of this products are now also automatically deleted, since they make no sense anymore then.

[*] Adjusted the propability of people buying overpriced models a bit:
  If you create a model with much too big price point, there will be still people buying the product (just like in the real world, like as status symbol) just as before but it now depends a bit more on the features and uniqueness of the product.

[*] Research points radars in ships and gps modules of phones have been adjusted a bit

[*] Fixed a problem causing the game to have stuttering music on some few systems sometimes

[/list]


Hope you like this update! Thanks for all the feedback so far, further feedback is welcome as always!

notes.title: Business Magnate 1.14 update
notes.notes:
Business Magnate update 1.14 is now available. 

This update adds multiple research tasks, new shortcuts for game speed and other various improvements here and there. Details here:
[list]
[*] Multiple Research Tasks
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942008/2effa477863b501b61296a85e395e6da10f8e5ce.jpg[/img]
  You can now create research tasks at once. Your team is still only able to run one research at the same time, but they can now be queued, just like the marketing campaigns in the version 1.12 update. Once the current research has finished, the next research in the queue gets started automatically, reducing the hassle of waiting for the next research the be finished before you can plan the next one.
  Already queued research can be viewed in the research overview screen, and can also be cancelled there before they start, in case you have changed your mind.
  
[*] New shortcuts for gamespeed
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942008/fe1815a618615bb3c01f14a981d13b5df1029321.jpg[/img]
   There are now a few keyboard shortcuts for setting the game speed:
	- Pause: Pauses and un-pauses the game
	- F6: Normal Speed
	- F7: Fast Speed
	- F8: Very Fast Speed
   
[*] The mail filter button in the mail dialog now has a tooltip so that it can be found easier by new players

[*] Fixed german translation for some gearbox texts

[*] Fixed a minor problem causing the settings dialog on chinese systems to be shown at a weired place sometimes

[/list]

Hope you like this update! Thanks for all the feedback so far, further feedback is welcome as always!

notes.title: Business Magnate 1.13 update
notes.notes:
Business Magnate update 1.13 is now available. 

This update adds performance improvements, the possibility to quickly re-produce what you did last time in a production facility, and various gameplay adjustments. Details here:
[list]
[*] Performance improvements
  Merged a few updates from the engine of our upcoming game "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1074180/Smart_City_Plan/]Smart City Plan[/url]", causing Business Magnate to run a bit faster on very slow systems.
  
[*] Repeat last production option
  Production buildings now store which product has been produced last time, and show this in the list when you start a new production, so it can be easily re-selected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942008/e88e8c86fd2ee4dda4ec3d3c6cc39aa43e4bbce3.jpg[/img]
   
[*] Competition AI: Prices of products created by the competition have been a bit adjusted again

[*] Research points of damage control systems in tanks and sonars in ships have been adjusted a bit.

[/list]

We are also currently thinking of adding a 'continuous production' option for end product to production buildings. If a lot of people want this and the tests go well, this will likely be added into the next update.
Hope you like this update! Thanks for all the feedback so far, further feedback is welcome as always!

notes.title: Business Magnate 1.12 update
notes.notes:
Business Magnate update 1.12 is now available. 

This update adds the possibility to filter your inbox for important messages only, an Advanced Rockets template for creating mods, and a few gameplay adjustments. Details here:

[list]
[*] Mail filters
  You can now define filters for mails you get in the game. For this, click the new button on the center right of the mail reader. 
  There, you can select not to receive any notifications anymore if a marketing campaign or hiring round has finished, if a delivery has arrived or if research has been done.
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942008/095d5de61726409fff6d2a3313b4f5221f8071cd.jpg[/img]
  
[*] Advanced Rockets Mod template
  A lot of people have requested this, so here is is now: A rocket mod template. If you want to create a space company with a bit different rocket configurations
  as in the default game, you can create a mod for this and base this on this new template now. This mod is based on the existing space company data and can be adjusted freely.
  Download it here: https://www.ambieragames.com/businessmagnate/mod_rockets_advanced.zip

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942008/8a7073114509caaaa62305ab97176b3ac8a2f1c8.jpg[/img] 

[*] Adjusted competition
  The competition AI now sets a bit more diverse prices for their products in some special cases

[*] Resources needed for Dataports for producing PCs have been adjusted slightly
[/list]


Hope you like this update! Thanks for all the feedback so far, further feedback is welcome as always!

notes.title: Business Magnate 1.9 update
notes.notes:
Business Magnate update 1.9 is now available. 

This update adds the possibility to plan multiple Marketing Campaigns, adjusts large basic resource ordering and adds a few tweaks and bug fixes. Details here:

[list]
[*] Multiple Marketing Campaigns
  You can now create multiple marketing campaigns at once. Your team is still only able to run one campaign at the same time, but they can now be queued. Once the current campaign has finished, the next campaign in the queue gets started automatically, reducing the hassle of waiting for the next campaign the be finished before you can plan the next one.
  Already queued campaigns can be viewed in the marketing overview screen, and can also be cancelled there before they start, in case you have changed your mind.
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942008/511c4d983e882ebece756c087bf99937364a9763.jpg[/img]
  
[*] Ordering very large amounts of base materials is now about 28% faster. 
  This is very useful if you run a company needing for example a lot of metal for manufacturing large ships.
 

[*] Adjusted the resources needed for producing improved collision avoidance when selling air planes.

[*] Adjusted needed time for researching thermal sights of tanks

[*] Fixed a small bug causing the auto-hire feature introduced in the 1.8 update only hire 99% of all needed employees sometimes instead of the needed 100%.
  This only happened in very large companies.
  
[*] Fixed a bug causing long product types not to show any text in the "Create new product" dialog in some languages
  
[*] Fixed a text in the german translation referencing the "Finances" tab in english language
[/list]


Hope you like this update! Thanks for all the feedback so far, further feedback is welcome as always!

notes.title: Business Magnate 1.8 update
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/950990/Business_Magnate/]Business Magnate update 1.8[/url] is now available. 

This update adds two of the most requested features: Market share statistics and the possibility to auto-hire new employees. Details here:

[list]
[*] Market Share Statistics
  There is now a market share statistics tab in the 'sales' dialog. This gives a nice overview of your company in relation to the competition. 
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942008/8a7073114509caaaa62305ab97176b3ac8a2f1c8.jpg[/img]
  

[*] Auto-Hire feature
  The game now has an auto-hire feature, which you can use if you don't want to manually re-hire employees all the time in large companies.
  Once your company reached a certain size, there will be a button in the 'Hire Employees' dialog, which enables this functionality. You 
  will also get a mail once this feature is unlocked.
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33942008/7963ccdc908080e73db47231d580ae27d23139c6.jpg[/img]
  

[*] Fixed a few minor formatting problems in some of the mails when language is set to german or french.

[*] Adjusted the material requirements of the "All wheel drive" drive-train of trucks a bit

[*] Changed the size of the electric vehicle battery for trucks and tanks (yes, you can build electric tanks in this game)
[/list]

The next update will likely add more possibilities to automate things in the game, like auto-marketing-campaigns.

Hope you like this update! Thanks for all the feedback so far, further feedback is welcome as always!

notes.title: Business Magnate 1.7 update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33942008/d8b2e076dc4abf2b0f43827b07dc308ccd15cf3b.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/950990/Business_Magnate/]Business Magnate update 1.7[/url] is now available. 

This update adds mod support (beta) and various small gameplay changes and improvements. Details here:

[list]
[*] Mod support
  You can now add your own mods to the game, and create games with new business types. There is now a section "Mod support" in the game manual, explaining how to do that.
  There is also a downloadable example mod available which adds the business type "calculators" to the game.
  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33942008/3df7a9109001178d58844efd4ea6c5c8efcf7860.png[/img]
  
  Note: This feature is new and still beta. It was tested, and seems to work nicely, but there might be still some bugs. Also, you need to have a bit of experience for creating mods, it is not that simple.  
  
[*] Bigger Warehouses
   Adjusted warehouse sizes a bit: The "Very large warehouse" now has 25% bigger storage space, and the "Large warehouse" has 30% more space.
 
[*] The 'bulldoze' item now has a bulldozer icon ontop of it, in order to make it more easily distingishable from other items in the list.

[*] Multifuel engines like the gas turbine for tank production had the tag "multifuel", which wasn't translated into any language, this is fixed now.

[*] Changed some strings to fix missing capitalization at some places in the UI

[*] Changed the text 'Monitoring' when producing planes to 'Monitors' which makes much more sense
[/list]

Hope you like this update! Thanks for all the feedback so far, further feedback is welcome as always!

notes.title: Business Magnate 1.6 update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33942008/d8b2e076dc4abf2b0f43827b07dc308ccd15cf3b.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/950990/Business_Magnate/]Business Magnate update 1.6[/url] is now available. 

This update adds a feature which users running many companies at the same time requested: The possibility to dissolve a company. It also includes a few other changes. Details here:

[list]
[*] Company dissolving
  You can now dissolve your companies if you want to. This will cause all employees to be dismissed, the land will be sold and all production stopped. This will only work for all but the last company you own, of course. It is very useful if you have more than one company and you decide not to continue with that particular business type.
  There is a new section 'Dissolve company' on the 'Finances' tab for this.
  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33942008/c8d5bcc5ce5d00b7b662241b39481fa78a4e5e6a.png[/img]

[*] WASD scrolling
  Since it was requested that often, it is now possible to use the keys 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D' in addition to the cursor keys on the keyboard to scroll the view.
 
[*] Fixed a problem where the graphics of delivered ships sometimes didn't match the actual produced ships

[*] Adjusted the amount of plastics required for certain configurations of air plane air conditioning systems

[*] Changed influenced values a bit for Dual-clutch transmission and Automatic gearboxes in tanks

[*] Optimized algorithm which decides which ware house is to be used after a product was produced and needs to be stored, reducing ways for trucks and fork lifts a bit sometimes 

[*] Improved a few texts in the spanish translation of the game
[/list]

Hope you like this update! Thanks for all the feedback so far, further feedback is welcome as always!

notes.title: Business Magnate 1.5 update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33942008/d8b2e076dc4abf2b0f43827b07dc308ccd15cf3b.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/950990/Business_Magnate/]Business Magnate update 1.5[/url] is now available. 

This update adds the most wished feature request: The possibility to extend your company's piece of land. It also includes a few other changes. Details here:

[list]
[*] [b]Site Extension[/b]
It is now possible to extend your company's piece of land. This was the most requested feature by players, and makes it possible to build a few more buildings if you have a very large company.
To do this, go to the finances tab -> Land -> click 'Expand the property'. You can only do this once, and it will cost you about 2,5 Mio $.
The game engine was not written with this in mind, so this took a bit of effort to implement, but it's now there and it works, hope you have fun with this new feature.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33942008/78286aac239a22b74c3cf77382f276532ad6b7b8.png[/img]

[*] [b]Spanish translation[/b]
The game is now available in spanish as well, making the game now available in 7 languages (Thanks, Crusly Bec!)

[*] Improved chart display when there are more than 5 comepting products displayed on the market segments overview in the sales tab.
[*] Improved parts of the russian translation (thanks to Николай)
[*] Improved performance with the bigger businesses which are possible to create now
[*] Changed needed resources for thrust reversers (when producing/selling airplanes) to be a bit more realistic and balanced
[*] Adjusted research points needed for thermal sight systems (when producing/selling tanks)
[*] Fixed some typos in the german translation and in the Manual (thanks to mine_skill)
[*] Fixed a problem when dragging game window accross multiple screens.
[/list]

Thanks for all the feedback so far, further feedback is welcome as always!

notes.title: Business Magnate 1.4 update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33942008/d8b2e076dc4abf2b0f43827b07dc308ccd15cf3b.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/950990/Business_Magnate/]Business Magnate update 1.4[/url] is now available. 

This update adds mostly gameplay tweaks, two new translations and some minor bug fixes here and there. Details of changes in this update:

[list]
[*] Added Italian translation
[*] Added Slovenian translation 
[*] Changed needed resources from several components like "Cruise Control with Lane Centering", "Landing Parachute Advanced", and "Dual-clutch Transmission" to be a bit more realistic.
[*] Marked simulation for special cases like electric tanks (yes, they are also possible) and cargo ships without stabilizers adjusted a bit.
[*] The combobox for changing the zoom on the bottom left in the game didn't open on some systems, this has been fixed now.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33942008/f102843e1e07074b728b83a5feced89e908b29db.png[/img]
[*] The zoom and scroll speed is now adjusted to the frames per second value, meaning that on slower PCs, scrolling is now also smooth
[/list]

Thanks for all the feedback so far, further feedback is welcome as always!

notes.title: Business Magnate 1.3 update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33942008/d8b2e076dc4abf2b0f43827b07dc308ccd15cf3b.jpg[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/950990/Business_Magnate/]Business Magnate update 1.3[/url] is now available. 

This update adds mostly bug fixes and a few minor improvements here and there. Details of changes in this update:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug which made it possible under circumstances to set a very high price for a product, and customers then would still buy it in large quantities. For example you could produce a very cheap SUV and sell it for 1 million $ instead of a more normal 25.000 $. This made it possible to become rich very quick, and was quite unrealistic. This was a glitch which has now been removed. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33942008/f9c05b0ae9c0a062b59c464dbd4ceeea4a815cf7.png[/img]

[*] Fixed a problem in the "Smartphone" business type causing tablets to have very low sales per day
[*] Fixed a bug causing very large money values like 20 billion to be shown as a negative value on the top of the game window. This was only a display error, you actually still had a positive account value. 
[*] Improved chinese and german translation a bit
[*] Adjusted a few minor values in the simulation to make the model work in some edge cases more realistically.
[/list]

There have been made a lot of new and interesting proposals for new features on the steam community forum, thank you for that! Some of these are probably going to be implemented for one of the next upcoming updates.

Further feedback is welcome as always!

notes.title: Business Magnate 1.2 update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33942008/d8b2e076dc4abf2b0f43827b07dc308ccd15cf3b.jpg[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/950990/Business_Magnate/]Business Magnate update 1.2[/url] is now available. 

This update adds some new features, two new supported languages (French and Russian), and a handful bugfixes. It also includes the most wanted "recurring supply orders" feature. Details of changes in this update:

[list]
[*] Automatic re-ordering supplies
  There is now an option to auto-reorder supplies, so you don't have to order for example metal every few minutes manually.
  Once you are able to produce a model automatically, this feature is enabled.
  There is now a new checkbox next to the "order" button which makes this possible. You can cancel automatic ordering again in the 'deliveries' tab.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33942008/712411b0ebd3f04f772150ef051eba80c46db5d3.png[/img]
[*] Fluctuation re-balanced
  If you are paying your employees well, they won't quit that often anymore. Also, they now quit in different patterns now, which are more realistic.  
[*]Maximum production amount increased
  You can now produce more than previously 200 items at the same time. Once you have produced more than 100 items, you can instruct any production facility to produce any item 500 times, and later even 1000 times.  
[*] Added french translation  
[*]Added russian translation 
[*] Fixed a problem occurring when ordering materials via automatic production: the money would sometimes not be removed from your account, this is fixed now.
[*] Fixed a bug causing the store overview dialog not to display anything sometimes when you had a lot of end products which you had stopped producing
[/list]

Thanks for all the feedback so far! Hope you'll like this update. 

Further feedback is welcome as always!

notes.title: Business Magnate 1.1 update
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/950990/Business_Magnate/]Business Magnate update 1.1[/url] is now available. 

This update adds some new minor features and a handful bugfixes. There are bigger features planned for the next update, like "recurring supply orders". Details of changes in this update:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33942008/19ef182afa5230af2cd9eaf64a925bbad0945ef4.png[/img]

[list]
[*] You can now manually enter the exact amount of supplies to order, using the keyboard, instead of just using the slider. Additionally, there are also up/down arrows for quickly adjusting the value.
[*] You can now hire more than 30 employees at the same time if you have a big company. Depending on the size, you can now hire 40 or even 50 employees at the same time.
[*] When running a "Computer" business, the first researchable graphics card component now has a much better performance than the base integrated graphics card "basic".
[*] The 'fluctuation' value has been adjusted a bit, causing very big companies not to lose employees that much anymore.
[*] Fixed a bug which would sometimes show the wrong finished research topics in your mail reader when you have more than one company
[*] Fixed problem which caused the game to start up with a black screen when you are running it on Windows with the language set to 'Chinese'
[*] Fixed a problem causing the game to run slowly when you have finished researching something and you run the game on Windows with the language set to 'Chinese'	
[*] Fixed a bug which caused the simulation to stop running sometimes if you delete a product or model while it is being produced automatically
[*] Fixed a few typos in the english version
[*] Fixed a bug which caused the current amount of workers to show up as '0' all the time in the production overview dialog
[/list]

Thanks for all the feedback so far! Hope you'll like this update. 

The most wanted new feature seems to be "recurring supply orders", which will be added with the next update, if everything goes right.

Further feedback is welcome as always!
